name: Sawa Ikusa Otome -Saikyou no Shinobu Kasumi-
original_name: 触戦乙女-最強の忍かすみ-
source:
Kasumi, a runaway searching for her missing brother, infiltrated a research facility. However, she was captured and became a guinea pig for experimentation. As tentacles rape her, her body is transformed. Her breasts are full of milk, her body is altered into something inhuman, and eventually, she is impregnated. At the end of all this, what awaited Kasumi was a fate beyond your wildest imagination...

[Translated from [url=http://vmax2.sakura.ne.jp/vanira/image/doujin/saikyounosinobikasumi/so_kasumi.htm]the official website[/url]]
translation:
为寻找失踪兄长而成为叛忍的霞，潜入了一座研究设施。然而她却不幸被俘，沦为实验的小白鼠。在触手的侵犯下，她的身体遭到改造——双乳盈满母乳，肉体被异化得不再似人，最终甚至被迫受孕。在这一切的尽头，等待着霞的将是超乎想象的命运……

[译自[url=http://vmax2.sakura.ne.jp/vanira/image/doujin/saikyounosinobikasumi/so_kasumi.htm]官方网站[/url]]
